title: The Fitness Market Is Booming, Especially for Low-Price Gyms, Investors Say - Athletech News

facts.fact: TSG Consumer Partners acquired EoS Fitness in 2025, reportedly valuing the brand at $1.5 billion (per the article's image caption).
facts.quote: TSG Consumer Partners acquired EoS Fitness in 2025, reportedly valuing the brand at $1.5 billion (credit: EoS Fitness)

facts.fact: At the HFA Show's annual financial panel, private equity and investment banking leaders said firms are ready to spend more on acquiring fitness brands.
facts.quote: private equity and investment banking leaders said firms are ready to spend more on acquiring fitness brands

facts.fact: Oura is set to acquire Counsel Health for $625M, according to a related headline on the page.
facts.quote: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M in Major Push Into AI-Powered Healthcare

facts.fact: YouFit Gyms received an investment of more than $10M to upgrade its clubs, according to a related headline on the page.
facts.quote: YouFit Gyms Gets $10M+ Investment to Upgrade Clubs

facts.fact: Equinox Chair Harvey Spevak led a $6.5M financing round for Vesalius Longevity Labs, according to a related headline on the page.
facts.quote: Equinox Chair Leads $6.5M Financing Round for Vesalius Longevity Labs

facts.fact: A white paper cited on the page estimates the inclusive fitness market in the US at $24B, which the headline says gyms are overlooking.
facts.quote: Gyms Are Overlooking a $24B Market for Inclusive Fitness, White Paper Finds
